text_en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ , according to the commandment of God our Saviour and Christ Jesus our hope :
text_la: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi secundum imperium Dei Salvatoris nostri, et Christi Jesu spei nostræ,
text_pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, segundo o mandado de Deus, nosso Salvador, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, esperança nossa,
text_el: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ κατ' ἐπιταγὴν θεοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τῆς ἐλπίδος ἡμῶν

text_en: To Timothy, his beloved son in faith . Grace , mercy and peace, from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord .
text_la: Timotheo dilecto filio in fide. Gratia, misericordia, et pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
text_pt: A Timóteo meu verdadeiro filho na fé: Graça, misericórdia e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e da de Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
text_el: Τιμοθέῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ ἐν πίστει: χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.

text_en: As I desired you to remain at Ephesus when I went into Macedonia, that you might charge some not to teach otherwise:
text_la: Sicut rogavi te ut remaneres Ephesi cum irem in Macedoniam, ut denuntiares quibusdam ne aliter docerent,
text_pt: Como te roguei, quando parti para a macedônia, que ficasses em Éfeso, para advertires a alguns, que não ensinem outra doutrina,
text_el: Καθὼς παρεκάλεσά σε προσμεῖναι ἐν Ἐφέσῳ πορευόμενος εἰς Μακεδονίαν, ἵνα παραγγείλῃς τισὶν μὴ ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖν

text_en: Not to give heed to fables and endless genealogies , which furnish questions rather than the edification of God which is in faith .
text_la: neque intenderent fabulis, et genealogiis interminatis : quæ quæstiones præstant magis quam ædificationem Dei, quæ est in fide.
text_pt: Nem se dêem a fábulas ou a genealogias intermináveis, que mais produzem questões do que edificação de Deus, que consiste na fé; assim o faço agora.
text_el: μηδὲ προσέχειν μύθοις καὶ γενεαλογίαις ἀπεράντοις, αἵτινες ἐκζητήσεις παρέχουσιν μᾶλλον ἢ οἰκονομίαν θεοῦ τὴν ἐν πίστει:

text_en: Now the end of the commandment is charity from a pure heart, and a good conscience , and an unfeigned faith .
text_la: Finis autem præcepti est caritas de corde puro, et conscientia bona, et fide non ficta.
text_pt: Ora, o fim do mandamento é o amor de um coração puro, e de uma boa consciência, e de uma fé não fingida.
text_el: τὸ δὲ τέλος τῆς παραγγελίας ἐστὶν ἀγάπη ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας καὶ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς καὶ πίστεως ἀνυποκρίτου,

text_en: From which things some, going astray, are turned aside unto vain babbling:
text_la: A quibus quidam aberrantes, conversi sunt in vaniloquium,
text_pt: Do que, desviando-se alguns, se entregaram a vãs contendas;
text_el: ὧν τινες ἀστοχήσαντες ἐξετράπησαν εἰς ματαιολογίαν,

text_en: Desiring to be teachers of the law : understanding neither the things they say, nor whereof they affirm.
text_la: volentes esse legis doctores, non intelligentes neque quæ loquuntur, neque de quibus affirmant.
text_pt: Querendo ser mestres da lei, e não entendendo nem o que dizem nem o que afirmam.
text_el: θέλοντες εἶναι νομοδιδάσκαλοι, μὴ νοοῦντες μήτε ἃ λέγουσιν μήτε περὶ τίνων διαβεβαιοῦνται.

text_en: But we know that the law is good , if a man use it lawfully.
text_la: Scimus autem quia bona est lex si quis ea legitime utatur:
text_pt: Sabemos, porém, que a lei é boa, se alguém dela usa legitimamente;
text_el: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι καλὸς ὁ νόμος ἐάν τις αὐτῷ νομίμως χρῆται,

text_en: Knowing this: That the law is not made for the just man but for the unjust and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for the wicked and defiled, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
text_la: sciens hoc quia lex justo non est posita, sed injustis, et non subditis, impiis, et peccatoribus, sceleratis, et contaminatis, parricidis, et matricidis, homicidis,
text_pt: Sabendo isto, que a lei não é feita para o justo, mas para os injustos e obstinados, para os ímpios e pecadores, para os profanos e irreligiosos, para os parricidas e matricidas, para os homicidas,
text_el: εἰδὼς τοῦτο, ὅτι δικαίῳ νόμος οὐ κεῖται, ἀνόμοις δὲ καὶ ἀνυποτάκτοις, ἀσεβέσι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοῖς, ἀνοσίοις καὶ βεβήλοις, πατρολῴαις καὶ μητρολῴαις, ἀνδροφόνοις,

text_en: for fornicators, for them who defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars , for perjured persons , and whatever other thing is contrary to sound doctrine :
text_la: fornicariis, masculorum concubitoribus, plagiariis, mendacibus, et perjuris, et si quid aliud sanæ doctrinæ adversatur,
text_pt: Para os devassos, para os sodomitas, para os roubadores de homens, para os mentirosos, para os perjuros, e para o que for contrário à sã doutrina,
text_el: πόρνοις, ἀρσενοκοίταις, ἀνδραποδισταῖς, ψεύσταις, ἐπιόρκοις, καὶ εἴ τι ἕτερον τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀντίκειται,

text_en: Which is according to the gospel of the glory of the blessed God which has been committed to my trust.
text_la: quæ est secundum Evangelium gloriæ beati Dei, quod creditum est mihi.
text_pt: Conforme o evangelho da glória de Deus bem-aventurado, que me foi confiado.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ μακαρίου θεοῦ, ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγώ.

text_en: I give him thanks who has strengthened me, even to Christ Jesus our Lord , for that he has counted me faithful, putting me in the ministry :
text_la: Gratias ago ei, qui me confortavit, Christo Jesu Domino nostro, quia fidelem me existimavit, ponens in ministerio:
text_pt: E dou graças ao que me tem confortado, a Cristo Jesus Senhor nosso, porque me teve por fiel, pondo-me no ministério;
text_el: χάριν ἔχω τῷ ἐνδυναμώσαντί με Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν, ὅτι πιστόν με ἡγήσατο θέμενος εἰς διακονίαν,

text_en: Who before was a blasphemer and a persecutor and contumelious . But I obtained the mercy of God , because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
text_la: qui prius blasphemus fui, et persecutor, et contumeliosus : sed misericordiam Dei consecutus sum, quia ignorans feci in incredulitate.
text_pt: A mim, que dantes fui blasfemo, e perseguidor, e injurioso; mas alcancei misericórdia, porque o fiz ignorantemente, na incredulidade.
text_el: τὸ πρότερον ὄντα βλάσφημον καὶ διώκτην καὶ ὑβριστήν: ἀλλὰ ἠλεήθην, ὅτι ἀγνοῶν ἐποίησα ἐν ἀπιστίᾳ,

text_en: Now the grace of our Lord has abounded exceedingly with faith and love , which is in Christ Jesus .
text_la: Superabundavit autem gratia Domini nostri cum fide, et dilectione, quæ est in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: E a graça de nosso Senhor superabundou com a fé e amor que há em Jesus Cristo.
text_el: ὑπερεπλεόνασεν δὲ ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μετὰ πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: A faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners , of whom I am the chief.
text_la: Fidelis sermo, et omni acceptione dignus : quod Christus Jesus venit in hunc mundum peccatores salvos facere, quorum primus ego sum.
text_pt: Esta é uma palavra fiel, e digna de toda a aceitação, que Cristo Jesus veio ao mundo, para salvar os pecadores, dos quais eu sou o principal.
text_el: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος, ὅτι Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἁμαρτωλοὺς σῶσαι, ὧν πρῶτός εἰμι ἐγώ:

text_en: But for this cause have I obtained mercy: that in me first Christ Jesus might show forth all patience, for the information of them that shall believe in him unto life everlasting .
text_la: Sed ideo misericordiam consecutus sum : ut in me primo ostenderet Christus Jesus omnem patientiam ad informationem eorum, qui credituri sunt illi, in vitam æternam.
text_pt: Mas por isso alcancei misericórdia, para que em mim, que sou o principal, Jesus Cristo mostrasse toda a sua longanimidade, para exemplo dos que haviam de crer nele para a vida eterna.
text_el: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἠλεήθην, ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ πρώτῳ ἐνδείξηται Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς τὴν ἅπασαν μακροθυμίαν, πρὸς ὑποτύπωσιν τῶν μελλόντων πιστεύειν ἐπ' αὐτῷ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: Now to the king of ages, immortal , invisible, the only God , be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen .
text_la: Regi autem sæculorum immortali, invisibili, soli Deo honor et gloria in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: Ora, ao Rei dos séculos, imortal, invisível, ao único Deus sábio, seja honra e glória para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: τῷ δὲ βασιλεῖ τῶν αἰώνων, ἀφθάρτῳ, ἀοράτῳ, μόνῳ θεῷ, τιμὴ καὶ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων: ἀμήν.

text_en: This precept , I commend to you, O son Timothy: according to the prophecies going before on you, that you war in them a good warfare ,
text_la: Hoc præceptum commendo tibi, fili Timothee, secundum præcedentes in te prophetias, ut milites in illis bonam militiam,
text_pt: Este mandamento te dou, meu filho Timóteo, que, segundo as profecias que houve acerca de ti, milites por elas boa milícia;
text_el: Ταύτην τὴν παραγγελίαν παρατίθεμαί σοι, τέκνον Τιμόθεε, κατὰ τὰς προαγούσας ἐπὶ σὲ προφητείας, ἵνα στρατεύῃ ἐν αὐταῖς τὴν καλὴν στρατείαν,

text_en: having faith and a good conscience , which some rejecting have made shipwreck concerning the faith .
text_la: habens fidem, et bonam conscientiam, quam quidam repellentes, circa fidem naufragaverunt:
text_pt: Conservando a fé, e a boa consciência, a qual alguns, rejeitando, fizeram naufrágio na fé.
text_el: ἔχων πίστιν καὶ ἀγαθὴν συνείδησιν, ἥν τινες ἀπωσάμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἐναυάγησαν:

text_en: Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander, whom I have delivered up to Satan , that they may learn not to blaspheme .
text_la: ex quibus est Hymenæus, et Alexander : quos tradidi Satanæ, ut discant non blasphemare.
text_pt: E entre esses foram Himeneu e Alexandre, os quais entreguei a Satanás, para que aprendam a não blasfemar.
text_el: ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος, οὓς παρέδωκα τῷ Σατανᾷ ἵνα παιδευθῶσιν μὴ βλασφημεῖν.

text_en: I desire therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers , intercessions and thanksgivings be made for all men :
text_la: Obsecro igitur primum omnium fieri obsecrationes, orationes, postulationes, gratiarum actiones, pro omnibus hominibus:
text_pt: Admoesto-te, pois, antes de tudo, que se façam deprecações, orações, intercessões, e ações de graças, por todos os homens;
text_el: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις, προσευχάς, ἐντεύξεις, εὐχαριστίας, ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων,

text_en: For kings and for all that are in high station: that we may lead a quiet and a peaceable life in all piety and chastity .
text_la: pro regibus, et omnibus qui in sublimitate sunt, ut quietam et tranquillam vitam agamus in omni pietate, et castitate:
text_pt: Pelos reis, e por todos os que estão em eminência, para que tenhamos uma vida quieta e sossegada, em toda a piedade e honestidade;
text_el: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων, ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι.

text_en: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour ,
text_la: hoc enim bonum est, et acceptum coram Salvatore nostro Deo,
text_pt: Porque isto é bom e agradável diante de Deus nosso Salvador,
text_el: τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,

text_en: who will have all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth .
text_la: qui omnes homines vult salvos fieri, et ad agnitionem veritatis venire.
text_pt: Que quer que todos os homens se salvem, e venham ao conhecimento da verdade.
text_el: ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν.

text_en: For there is one God : and one mediator of God and men , the man Christ Jesus :
text_la: Unus enim Deus, unus et mediator Dei et hominum homo Christus Jesus:
text_pt: Porque há um só Deus, e um só Mediador entre Deus e os homens, Jesus Cristo homem.
text_el: εἷς γὰρ θεός, εἷς καὶ μεσίτης θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων, ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς,

text_en: Who gave himself a redemption for all, a testimony in due times,
text_la: qui dedit redemptionem semetipsum pro omnibus, testimonium temporibus suis:
text_pt: O qual se deu a si mesmo em preço de redenção por todos, para servir de testemunho a seu tempo.
text_el: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων, τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις:

text_en: whereunto I am appointed a preacher and an apostle (I say the truth , I lie not), a doctor of the Gentiles in faith and truth .
text_la: in quo positus sum ego prædicator, et Apostolus (veritatem dico, non mentior) doctor gentium in fide, et veritate.
text_pt: Para o que (digo a verdade em Cristo, não minto) fui constituído pregador, e apóstolo, e doutor dos gentios na fé e na verdade.
text_el: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ ψεύδομαι διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.

text_en: I will therefore that men pray in every place, lifting up pure hands, without anger and contention.
text_la: Volo ergo viros orare in omni loco, levantes puras manus sine ira et disceptatione.
text_pt: Quero, pois, que os homens orem em todo o lugar, levantando mãos santas, sem ira nem contenda.
text_el: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμῶν.

text_en: In like manner, women also in decent apparel: adorning themselves with modesty and sobriety, not with plaited hair , or gold, or pearls, or costly attire:
text_la: Similiter et mulieres in habitu ornato, cum verecundia et sobrietate ornantes se, et non in tortis crinibus, aut auro, aut margaritas, vel veste pretiosa:
text_pt: Que do mesmo modo as mulheres se ataviem em traje honesto, com pudor e modéstia, não com tranças, ou com ouro, ou pérolas, ou vestidos preciosos,
text_el: Ὡσαύτως γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς, μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν καὶ χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ,

text_en: But, as it becomes women professing godliness , with good works .
text_la: sed quod decet mulieres, promittentes pietatem per opera bona.
text_pt: Mas (como convém a mulheres que fazem profissão de servir a Deus) com boas obras.
text_el: ἀλλ' ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν, δι' ἔργων ἀγαθῶν.

text_en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
text_la: Mulier in silentio discat cum omni subjectione.
text_pt: A mulher aprenda em silêncio, com toda a sujeição.
text_el: Γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ:

text_en: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to use authority over the man : but to be in silence.
text_la: Docere autem mulieri non permitto, neque dominari in virum : sed esse in silentio.
text_pt: Não permito, porém, que a mulher ensine, nem use de autoridade sobre o marido, mas que esteja em silêncio.
text_el: διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω, οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός, ἀλλ' εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.

text_en: For Adam was first formed; then Eve .
text_la: Adam enim primus formatus est : deinde Heva:
text_pt: Porque primeiro foi formado Adão, depois Eva.
text_el: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη, εἶτα Εὕα:

text_en: And Adam was not seduced; but the woman , being seduced, was in the transgression.
text_la: et Adam non est seductus: mulier autem seducta in prævaricatione fuit.
text_pt: E Adão não foi enganado, mas a mulher, sendo enganada, caiu em transgressão.
text_el: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν,

text_en: Yet she shall be saved through child bearing; if she continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.
text_la: Salvabitur autem per filiorum generationem, si permanserit in fide, et dilectione, et sanctificatione cum sobrietate.
text_pt: Salvar-se-á, porém, dando à luz filhos, se permanecer com modéstia na fé, no amor e na santificação.
text_el: σωθήσεται δὲ διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας, ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης.

text_en: A faithful saying: If a man desire the office of a bishop , he desires good work.
text_la: Fidelis sermo : si quis episcopatum desiderat, bonum opus desiderat.
text_pt: Esta é uma palavra fiel: se alguém deseja o episcopado, excelente obra deseja.
text_el: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος: εἴ τις ἐπισκοπῆς ὀρέγεται, καλοῦ ἔργου ἐπιθυμεῖ.

text_en: It behoves therefore a bishop to be blameless, the husband of one wife, sober, prudent , of good behaviour, chaste , given to hospitality, a teacher,
text_la: Oportet ergo episcopum irreprehensibilem esse, unius uxoris virum, sobrium, prudentem, ornatum, pudicum, hospitalem, doctorem,
text_pt: Convém, pois, que o bispo seja irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, vigilante, sóbrio, honesto, hospitaleiro, apto para ensinar;
text_el: δεῖ οὖν τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνεπίλημπτον εἶναι, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρα, νηφάλιον, σώφρονα, κόσμιον, φιλόξενον, διδακτικόν,

text_en: not given to wine , no striker, but modest, not quarrelsome, not covetous , but
text_la: non vinolentum, non percussorem, sed modestum : non litigiosum, non cupidum, sed
text_pt: Não dado ao vinho, não espancador, não cobiçoso de torpe ganância, mas moderado, não contencioso, não avarento;
text_el: μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, ἀλλὰ ἐπιεικῆ, ἄμαχον, ἀφιλάργυρον,

text_en: one that rules well his own house, having his children in subjection with all chastity .
text_la: suæ domui bene præpositum : filios habentem subditos cum omni castitate.
text_pt: Que governe bem a sua própria casa, tendo seus filhos em sujeição, com toda a modéstia
text_el: τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου καλῶς προϊστάμενον, τέκνα ἔχοντα ἐν ὑποταγῇ μετὰ πάσης σεμνότητος:

text_en: But if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God ?
text_la: Si quis autem domui suæ præesse nescit, quomodo ecclesiæ Dei diligentiam habebit?
text_pt: (Porque, se alguém não sabe governar a sua própria casa, terá cuidado da igreja de Deus? );
text_el: εἰ δέ τις τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου προστῆναι οὐκ οἶδεν, πῶς ἐκκλησίας θεοῦ ἐπιμελήσεται;

text_en: Not a neophyte : lest, being puffed up with pride , he fall into the judgment of the devil .
text_la: Non neophytum : ne in superbiam elatus, in judicium incidat diaboli.
text_pt: Não neófito, para que, ensoberbecendo-se, não caia na condenação do diabo.
text_el: μὴ νεόφυτον, ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς εἰς κρίμα ἐμπέσῃ τοῦ διαβόλου.

text_en: Moreover, he must have a good testimony of them who are without: lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil .
text_la: Oportet autem illum et testimonium habere bonum ab iis qui foris sunt, ut non in opprobrium incidat, et in laqueum diaboli.
text_pt: Convém também que tenha bom testemunho dos que estão de fora, para que não caia em afronta, e no laço do diabo.
text_el: δεῖ δὲ καὶ μαρτυρίαν καλὴν ἔχειν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔξωθεν, ἵνα μὴ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμπέσῃ καὶ παγίδα τοῦ διαβόλου.

text_en: Deacons in like manner: chaste , not double tongued, not given to much wine , not greedy of filthy lucre :
text_la: Diaconos similiter pudicos, non bilingues, non multo vino deditos, non turpe lucrum sectantes:
text_pt: Da mesma sorte os diáconos sejam honestos, não de língua dobre, não dados a muito vinho, não cobiçosos de torpe ganância;
text_el: διακόνους ὡσαύτως σεμνούς, μὴ διλόγους, μὴ οἴνῳ πολλῷ προσέχοντας, μὴ αἰσχροκερδεῖς,

text_en: Holding the mystery of faith in a pure conscience .
text_la: habentes mysterium fidei in conscientia pura.
text_pt: Guardando o mistério da fé numa consciência pura.
text_el: ἔχοντας τὸ μυστήριον τῆς πίστεως ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει.

text_en: And let these also first be proved: and so let them minister , having no crime.
text_la: Et hi autem probentur primum : et sic ministrent, nullum crimen habentes.
text_pt: E também estes sejam primeiro provados, depois sirvam, se forem irrepreensíveis.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι δὲ δοκιμαζέσθωσαν πρῶτον, εἶτα διακονείτωσαν ἀνέγκλητοι ὄντες.

text_en: The women in like manner: chaste , not slanderers , but sober, faithful in all things.
text_la: Mulieres similiter pudicas, non detrahentes, sobrias, fideles in omnibus.
text_pt: Da mesma sorte as esposas sejam honestas, não maldizentes, sóbrias e fiéis em tudo.
text_el: γυναῖκας ὡσαύτως σεμνάς, μὴ διαβόλους, νηφαλίους, πιστὰς ἐν πᾶσιν.

text_en: Let deacons be the husbands of one wife: who rule well their children and their own houses.
text_la: Diaconi sint unius uxoris viri, qui filiis suis bene præsint, et suis domibus.
text_pt: Os diáconos sejam maridos de uma só mulher, e governem bem a seus filhos e suas próprias casas.
text_el: διάκονοι ἔστωσαν μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρες, τέκνων καλῶς προϊστάμενοι καὶ τῶν ἰδίων οἴκων:

text_en: For they that have ministered well shall purchase to themselves a good degree and much confidence in the faith which is in Christ Jesus .
text_la: Qui enim bene ministraverint, gradum bonum sibi acquirent, et multam fiduciam in fide, quæ est in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: Porque os que servirem bem como diáconos, adquirirão para si uma boa posição e muita confiança na fé que há em Cristo Jesus.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ καλῶς διακονήσαντες βαθμὸν ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν περιποιοῦνται καὶ πολλὴν παρρησίαν ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: These things I write to you, hoping that I shall come to you shortly.
text_la: Hæc tibi scribo, sperans me ad te venire cito:
text_pt: Escrevo-te estas coisas, esperando ir ver-te bem depressa;
text_el: Ταῦτά σοι γράφω, ἐλπίζων ἐλθεῖν [πρὸς σὲ] ἐν τάχει:

text_en: But if I tarry long, that you may know how you ought to behave yourself in the house of God , which is the church of the living God , the pillar and ground of the truth .
text_la: si autem tardavero, ut scias quomodo oporteat te in domo Dei conversari, quæ est ecclesia Dei vivi, columna et firmamentum veritatis.
text_pt: Mas, se tardar, para que saibas como convém andar na casa de Deus, que é a igreja do Deus vivo, a coluna e firmeza da verdade.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ βραδύνω, ἵνα εἰδῇς πῶς δεῖ ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἀναστρέφεσθαι, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐκκλησία θεοῦ ζῶντος, στῦλος καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῆς ἀληθείας.

text_en: And evidently great is the mystery of godliness , which was manifested in the flesh, was justified in the spirit , appeared unto angels , has been preached unto the Gentiles , is believed in the world, is taken up in glory .
text_la: Et manifeste magnum est pietatis sacramentum, quod manifestatum est in carne, justificatum est in spiritu, apparuit angelis, prædicatum est gentibus, creditum est in mundo, assumptum est in gloria.
text_pt: E, sem dúvida alguma, grande é o mistério da piedade: Deus se manifestou em carne, foi justificado no Espírito, visto dos anjos, pregado aos gentios, crido no mundo, recebido acima na glória.
text_el: καὶ ὁμολογουμένως μέγα ἐστὶν τὸ τῆς εὐσεβείας μυστήριον: ὃς ἐφανερώθη ἐν σαρκί, ἐδικαιώθη ἐν πνεύματι, ὤφθη ἀγγέλοις, ἐκηρύχθη ἐν ἔθνεσιν, ἐπιστεύθη ἐν κόσμῳ, ἀνελήμφθη ἐν δόξῃ.

text_en: Now the Spirit manifestly says that in the last times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to spirits of error and doctrines of devils ,
text_la: Spiritus autem manifeste dicit, quia in novissimis temporibus discedent quidam a fide, attendentes spiritibus erroris, et doctrinis dæmoniorum,
text_pt: Mas o Espírito expressamente diz que nos últimos tempos apostatarão alguns da fé, dando ouvidos a espíritos enganadores, e a doutrinas de demônios;
text_el: Τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ῥητῶς λέγει ὅτι ἐν ὑστέροις καιροῖς ἀποστήσονταί τινες τῆς πίστεως, προσέχοντες πνεύμασιν πλάνοις καὶ διδασκαλίαις δαιμονίων,

text_en: speaking lies in hypocrisy and having their conscience seared,
text_la: in hypocrisi loquentium mendacium, et cauteriatam habentium suam conscientiam,
text_pt: Pela hipocrisia de homens que falam mentiras, tendo cauterizada a sua própria consciência;
text_el: ἐν ὑποκρίσει ψευδολόγων, κεκαυστηριασμένων τὴν ἰδίαν συνείδησιν,

text_en: forbidding to marry , to abstain from meats, which God has created to be received with thanksgiving by the faithful and by them that have known the truth .
text_la: prohibentium nubere, abstinere a cibis, quod Deus creavit ad percipiendum cum gratiarum actione fidelibus, et iis qui cognoverunt veritatem.
text_pt: Proibindo o casamento, e ordenando a abstinência dos alimentos que Deus criou para os fiéis, e para os que conhecem a verdade, a fim de usarem deles com ações de graças;
text_el: κωλυόντων γαμεῖν, ἀπέχεσθαι βρωμάτων ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἔκτισεν εἰς μετάλημψιν μετὰ εὐχαριστίας τοῖς πιστοῖς καὶ ἐπεγνωκόσι τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

text_en: For every creature of God is good , and nothing to be rejected that is received with thanksgiving:
text_la: Quia omnis creatura Dei bona est, et nihil rejiciendum quod cum gratiarum actione percipitur:
text_pt: Porque toda a criatura de Deus é boa, e não há nada que rejeitar, sendo recebido com ações de graças.
text_el: ὅτι πᾶν κτίσμα θεοῦ καλόν, καὶ οὐδὲν ἀπόβλητον μετὰ εὐχαριστίας λαμβανόμενον,

text_en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .
text_la: sanctificatur enim per verbum Dei, et orationem.
text_pt: Porque pela palavra de Deus e pela oração é santificada.
text_el: ἁγιάζεται γὰρ διὰ λόγου θεοῦ καὶ ἐντεύξεως.

text_en: These things proposing to the brethren, you shall be a good minister of Christ Jesus , nourished up in the words of faith and of the good doctrine which you have attained unto.
text_la: Hæc proponens fratribus, bonus eris minister Christi Jesu enutritus verbis fidei, et bonæ doctrinæ, quam assecutus es.
text_pt: Propondo estas coisas aos irmãos, serás bom ministro de Jesus Cristo, criado com as palavras da fé e da boa doutrina que tens seguido.
text_el: ταῦτα ὑποτιθέμενος τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καλὸς ἔσῃ διάκονος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐντρεφόμενος τοῖς λόγοις τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς καλῆς διδασκαλίας ᾗ παρηκολούθηκας:

text_en: But avoid foolish and old wives fables: and exercise yourself unto godliness .
text_la: Ineptas autem, et aniles fabulas devita : exerce autem teipsum ad pietatem.
text_pt: Mas rejeita as fábulas profanas e de velhas, e exercita-te a ti mesmo em piedade;
text_el: τοὺς δὲ βεβήλους καὶ γραώδεις μύθους παραιτοῦ. γύμναζε δὲ σεαυτὸν πρὸς εὐσέβειαν:

text_en: For bodily exercise is profitable to little: but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the life that now is and of that which is to come.
text_la: Nam corporalis exercitatio, ad modicum utilis est : pietas autem ad omnia utilis est, promissionem habens vitæ, quæ nunc est, et futuræ.
text_pt: Porque o exercício corporal para pouco aproveita, mas a piedade para tudo é proveitosa, tendo a promessa da vida presente e da que há de vir.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ σωματικὴ γυμνασία πρὸς ὀλίγον ἐστὶν ὠφέλιμος, ἡ δὲ εὐσέβεια πρὸς πάντα ὠφέλιμός ἐστιν, ἐπαγγελίαν ἔχουσα ζωῆς τῆς νῦν καὶ τῆς μελλούσης.

text_en: A faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
text_la: Fidelis sermo, et omni acceptione dignus.
text_pt: Esta palavra é fiel e digna de toda a aceitação;
text_el: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος:

text_en: For therefore we labour and are reviled , because we hope in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , especially of the faithful .
text_la: In hoc enim laboramus, et maledicimur, quia speramus in Deum vivum, qui est Salvator omnium hominum, maxime fidelium.
text_pt: Porque para isto trabalhamos e somos injuriados, pois esperamos no Deus vivo, que é o Salvador de todos os homens, principalmente dos fiéis.
text_el: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ κοπιῶμεν καὶ ἀγωνιζόμεθα, ὅτι ἠλπίκαμεν ἐπὶ θεῷ ζῶντι, ὅς ἐστιν σωτὴρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων, μάλιστα πιστῶν.

text_en: These things command and teach:
text_la: Præcipe hæc, et doce.
text_pt: Manda estas coisas e ensina-as.
text_el: Παράγγελλε ταῦτα καὶ δίδασκε.

text_en: Let no man despise your youth: but be an example of the faithful , in word, in conversation, in charity , in faith , in chastity .
text_la: Nemo adolescentiam tuam contemnat : sed exemplum esto fidelium in verbo, in conversatione, in caritate, in fide, in castitate.
text_pt: Ninguém despreze a tua mocidade; mas sê o exemplo dos fiéis, na palavra, no trato, no amor, no espírito, na fé, na pureza.
text_el: μηδείς σου τῆς νεότητος καταφρονείτω, ἀλλὰ τύπος γίνου τῶν πιστῶν ἐν λόγῳ, ἐν ἀναστροφῇ, ἐν ἀγάπῃ, ἐν πίστει, ἐν ἁγνείᾳ.

text_en: Till I come, attend unto reading, to exhortation and to doctrine .
text_la: Dum venio, attende lectioni, exhortationi, et doctrinæ.
text_pt: Persiste em ler, exortar e ensinar, até que eu vá.
text_el: ἕως ἔρχομαι πρόσεχε τῇ ἀναγνώσει, τῇ παρακλήσει, τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ.

text_en: Neglect not the grace that is in you, which was given you by prophecy , with imposition of the hands of the priesthood .
text_la: Noli negligere gratiam, quæ in te est, quæ data est tibi per prophetiam, cum impositione manuum presbyterii.
text_pt: Não desprezes o dom que há em ti, o qual te foi dado por profecia, com a imposição das mãos do presbitério.
text_el: μὴ ἀμέλει τοῦ ἐν σοὶ χαρίσματος, ὃ ἐδόθη σοι διὰ προφητείας μετὰ ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τοῦ πρεσβυτερίου.

text_en: Meditate upon these things, be wholly in these things: that your profiting may be manifest to all.
text_la: Hæc meditare, in his esto : ut profectus tuus manifestus sit omnibus.
text_pt: Medita estas coisas; ocupa-te nelas, para que o teu aproveitamento seja manifesto a todos.
text_el: ταῦτα μελέτα, ἐν τούτοις ἴσθι, ἵνα σου ἡ προκοπὴ φανερὰ ᾖ πᾶσιν.

text_en: Take heed to yourself and to doctrine : be earnest in them. For in doing this you shall both save yourself and them that hear you.
text_la: Attende tibi, et doctrinæ : insta in illis. Hoc enim faciens, et teipsum salvum facies, et eos qui te audiunt.
text_pt: Tem cuidado de ti mesmo e da doutrina. Persevera nestas coisas; porque, fazendo isto, te salvarás, tanto a ti mesmo como aos que te ouvem.
text_el: ἔπεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ: ἐπίμενε αὐτοῖς: τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν καὶ σεαυτὸν σώσεις καὶ τοὺς ἀκούοντάς σου.

text_en: An ancient man rebuke not, but entreat him as a father: young men, as brethren:
text_la: Seniorem ne increpaveris, sed obsecra ut patrem : juvenes, ut fratres:
text_pt: NÃO repreendas asperamente o ancião, mas admoesta-o como a pai; aos moços como a irmãos;
text_el: Πρεσβυτέρῳ μὴ ἐπιπλήξῃς, ἀλλὰ παρακάλει ὡς πατέρα, νεωτέρους ὡς ἀδελφούς,

text_en: Old women , as mothers: young women , as sisters, in all chastity .
text_la: anus, ut matres : juvenculas, ut sorores in omni castitate:
text_pt: As mulheres idosas, como a mães, às moças, como a irmãs, em toda a pureza.
text_el: πρεσβυτέρας ὡς μητέρας, νεωτέρας ὡς ἀδελφὰς ἐν πάσῃ ἁγνείᾳ.

text_en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
text_la: viduas honora, quæ vere viduæ sunt.
text_pt: Honra as viúvas que verdadeiramente são viúvas.
text_el: Χήρας τίμα τὰς ὄντως χήρας.

text_en: But if any widow have children or grandchildren, let her learn first to govern her own house and to make a return of duty to her parents ; for this is acceptable before God .
text_la: Si qua autem vidua filios, aut nepotes habet : discat primum domum suam regere, et mutuam vicem reddere parentibus : hoc enim acceptum est coram Deo.
text_pt: Mas, se alguma viúva tiver filhos, ou netos, aprendam primeiro a exercer piedade para com a sua própria família, e a recompensar seus pais; porque isto é bom e agradável diante de Deus.
text_el: εἰ δέ τις χήρα τέκνα ἢ ἔκγονα ἔχει, μανθανέτωσαν πρῶτον τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον εὐσεβεῖν καὶ ἀμοιβὰς ἀποδιδόναι τοῖς προγόνοις, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, let her trust in God and continue in supplications and prayers night and day.
text_la: Quæ autem vere vidua est, et desolata, speret in Deum, et instet obsecrationibus, et orationibus nocte ac die.
text_pt: Ora, a que é verdadeiramente viúva e desamparada espera em Deus, e persevera de noite e de dia em rogos e orações;
text_el: ἡ δὲ ὄντως χήρα καὶ μεμονωμένη ἤλπικεν ἐπὶ [τὸν] θεὸν καὶ προσμένει ταῖς δεήσεσιν καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας:

text_en: For she that lives in pleasures is dead while she is living.
text_la: Nam quæ in deliciis est, vivens mortua est.
text_pt: Mas a que vive em deleites, vivendo está morta.
text_el: ἡ δὲ σπαταλῶσα ζῶσα τέθνηκεν.

text_en: And this give in charge, that they may be blameless.
text_la: Et hoc præcipe, ut irreprehensibiles sint.
text_pt: Manda, pois, estas coisas, para que elas sejam irrepreensíveis.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα παράγγελλε, ἵνα ἀνεπίλημπτοι ὦσιν.

text_en: But if any man have not care of his own and especially of those of his house, he has denied the faith and is worse than an infidel .
text_la: Si quis autem suorum, et maxime domesticorum, curam non habet, fidem negavit, et est infideli deterior.
text_pt: Mas, se alguém não tem cuidado dos seus, e principalmente dos da sua família, negou a fé, e é pior do que o infiel.
text_el: εἰ δέ τις τῶν ἰδίων καὶ μάλιστα οἰκείων οὐ προνοεῖ, τὴν πίστιν ἤρνηται καὶ ἔστιν ἀπίστου χείρων.

text_en: Let a widow be chosen of no less than threescore years of age, who has been the wife of one husband.
text_la: Vidua eligatur non minus sexaginta annorum, quæ fuerit unius viri uxor,
text_pt: Nunca seja inscrita viúva com menos de sessenta anos, e só a que tenha sido mulher de um só marido;
text_el: χήρα καταλεγέσθω μὴ ἔλαττον ἐτῶν ἑξήκοντα γεγονυῖα, ἑνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή,

text_en: Having testimony for her good works , if she have brought up children, if she have received to harbour, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have ministered to them that suffer tribulation, if she have diligently followed every good work .
text_la: in operibus bonis testimonium habens, si filios educavit, si hospitio recepit, si sanctorum pedes lavit, si tribulationem patientibus subministravit, si omne opus bonum subsecuta est.
text_pt: Tendo testemunho de boas obras: Se criou os filhos, se exercitou hospitalidade, se lavou os pés aos santos, se socorreu os aflitos, se praticou toda a boa obra.
text_el: ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς μαρτυρουμένη, εἰ ἐτεκνοτρόφησεν, εἰ ἐξενοδόχησεν, εἰ ἁγίων πόδας ἔνιψεν, εἰ θλιβομένοις ἐπήρκεσεν, εἰ παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ ἐπηκολούθησεν.

text_en: But the younger widows avoid. For when they have grown wanton in Christ , they will marry :
text_la: Adolescentiores autem viduas devita : cum enim luxuriatæ fuerint in Christo, nubere volunt:
text_pt: Mas não admitas as viúvas mais novas, porque, quando se tornam levianas contra Cristo, querem casar-se;
text_el: νεωτέρας δὲ χήρας παραιτοῦ: ὅταν γὰρ καταστρηνιάσωσιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ, γαμεῖν θέλουσιν,

text_en: Having damnation, because they have made void their first faith .
text_la: habentes damnationem, quia primam fidem irritam fecerunt;
text_pt: Tendo já a sua condenação por haverem aniquilado a primeira fé.
text_el: ἔχουσαι κρίμα ὅτι τὴν πρώτην πίστιν ἠθέτησαν:

text_en: And withal being idle they learn to go about from house to house: and are not only idle, but tattlers also and busy bodies, speaking things which they ought not.
text_la: simul autem et otiosæ discunt circuire domos : non solum otiosæ, sed et verbosæ, et curiosæ, loquentes quæ non oportet.
text_pt: E, além disto, aprendem também a andar ociosas de casa em casa; e não só ociosas, mas também paroleiras e curiosas, falando o que não convém.
text_el: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν, περιερχόμεναι τὰς οἰκίας, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀργαὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ φλύαροι καὶ περίεργοι, λαλοῦσαι τὰ μὴ δέοντα.

text_en: I will, therefore, that the younger should marry , bear children, be mistresses of families , give no occasion to the adversary to speak evil .
text_la: Volo ergo juniores nubere, filios procreare, matresfamilias esse, nullam occasionem dare adversario maledicti gratia.
text_pt: Quero, pois, que as que são moças se casem, gerem filhos, governem a casa, e não dêem ocasião ao adversário de maldizer;
text_el: βούλομαι οὖν νεωτέρας γαμεῖν, τεκνογονεῖν, οἰκοδεσποτεῖν, μηδεμίαν ἀφορμὴν διδόναι τῷ ἀντικειμένῳ λοιδορίας χάριν:

text_en: For some are already turned aside after Satan .
text_la: Jam enim quædam conversæ sunt retro Satanam.
text_pt: Porque já algumas se desviaram, indo após Satanás.
text_el: ἤδη γάρ τινες ἐξετράπησαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Σατανᾶ.

text_en: If any of the faithful have widows , let him minister to them, and let not the church be charged: that there may be sufficient for them that are widows indeed.
text_la: Si quis fidelis habet viduas, subministret illis, et non gravetur ecclesia : ut iis quæ vere viduæ sunt, sufficiat.
text_pt: Se algum crente ou alguma crente tem viúvas, socorra-as, e não se sobrecarregue a igreja, para que se possam sustentar as que deveras são viúvas.
text_el: εἴ τις πιστὴ ἔχει χήρας, ἐπαρκείτω αὐταῖς, καὶ μὴ βαρείσθω ἡ ἐκκλησία, ἵνα ταῖς ὄντως χήραις ἐπαρκέσῃ.

text_en: Let the priests that rule well be esteemed worthy of double honour : especially they who labour in the word and doctrine .
text_la: Qui bene præsunt presbyteri, duplici honore digni habeantur : maxime qui laborant in verbo et doctrina.
text_pt: Os presbíteros que governam bem sejam estimados por dignos de duplicada honra, principalmente os que trabalham na palavra e na doutrina;
text_el: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν, μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ:

text_en: For the scripture says: You shall not muzzle the ox that treads out the corn: and, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
text_la: Dicit enim Scriptura : Non alligabis os bovi trituranti. Et : Dignus est operarius mercede sua.
text_pt: Porque diz a Escritura: Não ligarás a boca ao boi que debulha. E: Digno é o obreiro do seu salário.
text_el: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή, βοῦν ἀλοῶντα οὐ φιμώσεις: καί, ἄξιος ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Against a priest receive not an accusation, but under two or three witnesses .
text_la: Adversus presbyterum accusationem noli recipere, nisi sub duobus aut tribus testibus.
text_pt: Não aceites acusação contra o presbítero, senão com duas ou três testemunhas.
text_el: κατὰ πρεσβυτέρου κατηγορίαν μὴ παραδέχου, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπὶ δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων.

text_en: Them that sin reprove before all that the rest also may have fear .
text_la: Peccantes coram omnibus argue: ut et ceteri timorem habeant.
text_pt: Aos que pecarem, repreende-os na presença de todos, para que também os outros tenham temor.
text_el: Τοὺς [δὲ] ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐνώπιον πάντων ἔλεγχε, ἵνα καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ φόβον ἔχωσιν.

text_en: I charge you, before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels , that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by declining to either side.
text_la: Testor coram Deo et Christo Jesu, et electis angelis, ut hæc custodias sine præjudicio, nihil faciens in alteram partem declinando.
text_pt: Conjuro-te diante de Deus, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e dos anjos eleitos, que sem prevenção guardes estas coisas, nada fazendo por parcialidade.
text_el: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν ἀγγέλων, ἵνα ταῦτα φυλάξῃς χωρὶς προκρίματος, μηδὲν ποιῶν κατὰ πρόσκλισιν.

text_en: Impose not hands lightly upon any man , neither be partaker of other men's sins . Keep yourself chaste .
text_la: Manus cito nemini imposueris, neque communicaveris peccatis alienis. Teipsum castum custodi.
text_pt: A ninguém imponhas precipitadamente as mãos, nem participes dos pecados alheios; conserva-te a ti mesmo puro.
text_el: Χεῖρας ταχέως μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει, μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις: σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν τήρει.

text_en: Do not still drink water, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and your frequent infirmities.
text_la: Noli adhuc aquam bibere, sed modico vino utere propter stomachum tuum, et frequentes tuas infirmitates.
text_pt: Não bebas mais água só, mas usa de um pouco de vinho, por causa do teu estômago e das tuas freqüentes enfermidades.
text_el: μηκέτι ὑδροπότει, ἀλλὰ οἴνῳ ὀλίγῳ χρῶ διὰ τὸν στόμαχον καὶ τὰς πυκνάς σου ἀσθενείας.

text_en: Some men's sins are manifest, going before to judgment: and some men they follow after.
text_la: Quorumdam hominum peccata manifesta sunt, præcedentia ad judicium : quosdam autem et subsequuntur.
text_pt: Os pecados de alguns homens são manifestos, precedendo o juízo; e em alguns manifestam-se depois.
text_el: τινῶν ἀνθρώπων αἱ ἁμαρτίαι πρόδηλοί εἰσιν, προάγουσαι εἰς κρίσιν, τισὶν δὲ καὶ ἐπακολουθοῦσιν:

text_en: In like manner also good deeds are manifest: and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
text_la: Similiter et facta bona, manifesta sunt : et quæ aliter se habent, abscondi non possunt.
text_pt: Assim mesmo também as boas obras são manifestas, e as que são de outra maneira não podem ocultar-se.
text_el: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὰ ἔργα τὰ καλὰ πρόδηλα, καὶ τὰ ἄλλως ἔχοντα κρυβῆναι οὐ δύνανται.

text_en: Whosoever are servants under the yoke, let them count their masters worthy of all honour ; lest the name of the Lord and his doctrine be blasphemed .
text_la: Quicumque sunt sub jugo servi, dominos suos omni honore dignos arbitrentur, ne nomen Domini et doctrina blasphemetur.
text_pt: Todos os servos que estão debaixo do jugo estimem a seus senhores por dignos de toda a honra, para que o nome de Deus e a doutrina não sejam blasfemados.
text_el: Ὅσοι εἰσὶν ὑπὸ ζυγὸν δοῦλοι, τοὺς ἰδίους δεσπότας πάσης τιμῆς ἀξίους ἡγείσθωσαν, ἵνα μὴ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἡ διδασκαλία βλασφημῆται.

text_en: But they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but serve them the rather, because they are faithful and beloved, who are partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
text_la: Qui autem fideles habent dominos, non contemnant, quia fratres sunt : sed magis serviant, quia fideles sunt et dilecti, qui beneficii participes sunt. Hæc doce, et exhortare.
text_pt: E os que têm senhores crentes não os desprezem, por serem irmãos; antes os sirvam melhor, porque eles, que participam do benefício, são crentes e amados. Isto ensina e exorta.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πιστοὺς ἔχοντες δεσπότας μὴ καταφρονείτωσαν, ὅτι ἀδελφοί εἰσιν: ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον δουλευέτωσαν, ὅτι πιστοί εἰσιν καὶ ἀγαπητοὶ οἱ τῆς εὐεργεσίας ἀντιλαμβανόμενοι. Ταῦτα δίδασκε καὶ παρακάλει.

text_en: If any man teach otherwise and consent not to the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and to that doctrine which is according to godliness ,
text_la: Si quis aliter docet, et non acquiescit sanis sermonibus Domini nostri Jesu Christi, et ei, quæ secundum pietatem est, doctrinæ:
text_pt: Se alguém ensina alguma outra doutrina, e se não conforma com as sãs palavras de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e com a doutrina que é segundo a piedade,
text_el: εἴ τις ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖ καὶ μὴ προσέρχεται ὑγιαίνουσιν λόγοις, τοῖς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ τῇ κατ' εὐσέβειαν διδασκαλίᾳ,

text_en: he is proud , knowing nothing, but sick about questions and strifes of words; from which arise envies , contentions, blasphemies , evil suspicions,
text_la: superbus est, nihil sciens, sed languens circa quæstiones, et pugnas verborum : ex quibus oriuntur invidiæ, contentiones, blasphemiæ, suspiciones malæ,
text_pt: É soberbo, e nada sabe, mas delira acerca de questões e contendas de palavras, das quais nascem invejas, porfias, blasfêmias, ruins suspeitas,
text_el: τετύφωται, μηδὲν ἐπιστάμενος, ἀλλὰ νοσῶν περὶ ζητήσεις καὶ λογομαχίας, ἐξ ὧν γίνεται φθόνος, ἔρις, βλασφημίαι, ὑπόνοιαι πονηραί,

text_en: conflicts of men corrupted in mind and who are destitute of the truth , supposing gain to be godliness .
text_la: conflictationes hominum mente corruptorum, et qui veritate privati sunt, existimantium quæstum esse pietatem.
text_pt: Perversas contendas de homens corruptos de entendimento, e privados da verdade, cuidando que a piedade seja causa de ganho; aparta-te dos tais.
text_el: διαπαρατριβαὶ διεφθαρμένων ἀνθρώπων τὸν νοῦν καὶ ἀπεστερημένων τῆς ἀληθείας, νομιζόντων πορισμὸν εἶναι τὴν εὐσέβειαν.

text_en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
text_la: Est autem quæstus magnus pietas cum sufficientia.
text_pt: Mas é grande ganho a piedade com contentamento.
text_el: ἔστιν δὲ πορισμὸς μέγας ἡ εὐσέβεια μετὰ αὐταρκείας:

text_en: For we brought nothing into this world: and certainly we can carry nothing out.
text_la: Nihil enim intulimus in hunc mundum : haud dubium quod nec auferre quid possumus.
text_pt: Porque nada trouxemos para este mundo, e manifesto é que nada podemos levar dele.
text_el: οὐδὲν γὰρ εἰσηνέγκαμεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον, ὅτι οὐδὲ ἐξενεγκεῖν τι δυνάμεθα:

text_en: But having food and wherewith to be covered, with these we are content.
text_la: Habentes autem alimenta, et quibus tegamur, his contenti simus.
text_pt: Tendo, porém, sustento, e com que nos cobrirmos, estejamos com isso contentes.
text_el: ἔχοντες δὲ διατροφὰς καὶ σκεπάσματα, τούτοις ἀρκεσθησόμεθα.

text_en: For they that will become rich fall into temptation and into the snare of the devil and into many unprofitable and hurtful desires, which drown men into destruction and perdition.
text_la: Nam qui volunt divites fieri, incidunt in tentationem, et in laqueum diaboli, et desideria multa inutilia, et nociva, quæ mergunt homines in interitum et perditionem.
text_pt: Mas os que querem ser ricos caem em tentação, e em laço, e em muitas concupiscências loucas e nocivas, que submergem os homens na perdição e ruína.
text_el: οἱ δὲ βουλόμενοι πλουτεῖν ἐμπίπτουσιν εἰς πειρασμὸν καὶ παγίδα καὶ ἐπιθυμίας πολλὰς ἀνοήτους καὶ βλαβεράς, αἵτινες βυθίζουσιν τοὺς ἀνθρώπους εἰς ὄλεθρον καὶ ἀπώλειαν:

text_en: For the desire of money is the root of all evils ; which some coveting have erred from the faith and have entangled themselves in many sorrows.
text_la: Radix enim omnium malorum est cupiditas : quam quidam appetentes erraverunt a fide, et inseruerunt se doloribus multis.
text_pt: Porque o amor ao dinheiro é a raiz de toda a espécie de males; e nessa cobiça alguns se desviaram da fé, e se traspassaram a si mesmos com muitas dores.
text_el: ῥίζα γὰρ πάντων τῶν κακῶν ἐστιν ἡ φιλαργυρία, ἧς τινες ὀρεγόμενοι ἀπεπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς πίστεως καὶ ἑαυτοὺς περιέπειραν ὀδύναις πολλαῖς.

text_en: But you, O man of God , fly these things: and pursue justice , godliness , faith , charity , patience, mildness.
text_la: Tu autem, o homo Dei, hæc fuge : sectare vero justitiam, pietatem, fidem, caritatem, patientiam, mansuetudinem.
text_pt: Mas tu, ó homem de Deus, foge destas coisas, e segue a justiça, a piedade, a fé, o amor, a paciência, a mansidão.
text_el: Σὺ δέ, ὦ ἄνθρωπε θεοῦ, ταῦτα φεῦγε: δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, εὐσέβειαν, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, ὑπομονήν, πραϋπαθίαν.

text_en: Fight the good fight of faith . Lay hold on eternal life , whereunto you are called and be it confessed a good confession before many witnesses .
text_la: Certa bonum certamen fidei, apprehende vitam æternam, in qua vocatus es, et confessus bonam confessionem coram multis testibus.
text_pt: Milita a boa milícia da fé, toma posse da vida eterna, para a qual também foste chamado, tendo já feito boa confissão diante de muitas testemunhas.
text_el: ἀγωνίζου τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα τῆς πίστεως, ἐπιλαβοῦ τῆς αἰωνίου ζωῆς, εἰς ἣν ἐκλήθης καὶ ὡμολόγησας τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν ἐνώπιον πολλῶν μαρτύρων.

text_en: I charge you before God who quickens all things, and before Christ Jesus who gave testimony under Pontius Pilate , a good confession:
text_la: Præcipio tibi coram Deo, qui vivificat omnia, et Christo Jesu, qui testimonium reddidit sub Pontio Pilato, bonam confessionem,
text_pt: Mando-te diante de Deus, que todas as coisas vivifica, e de Cristo Jesus, que diante de Pôncio Pilatos deu o testemunho de boa confissão,
text_el: παραγγέλλω σοι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ζῳογονοῦντος τὰ πάντα καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ μαρτυρήσαντος ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου τὴν καλὴν ὁμολογίαν,

text_en: That you keep the commandment without spot, blameless, unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
text_la: ut serves mandatum sine macula, irreprehensibile usque in adventum Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
text_pt: Que guardes este mandamento sem mácula e repreensão, até à aparição de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;
text_el: τηρῆσαί σε τὴν ἐντολὴν ἄσπιλον ἀνεπίλημπτον μέχρι τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: which in his times he shall show, who is the Blessed and only Mighty, the King of kings and Lord of lords:
text_la: quem suis temporibus ostendet beatus et solus potens, Rex regum, et Dominus dominantium:
text_pt: A qual a seu tempo mostrará o bem-aventurado, e único poderoso Senhor, Rei dos reis e Senhor dos senhores;
text_el: ἣν καιροῖς ἰδίοις δείξει ὁ μακάριος καὶ μόνος δυνάστης, ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν βασιλευόντων καὶ κύριος τῶν κυριευόντων,

text_en: Who only has immortality and inhabits light inaccessible: whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and empire everlasting. Amen .
text_la: qui solus habet immortalitatem, et lucem inhabitat inaccessibilem : quem nullus hominum vidit, sed nec videre potest : cui honor, et imperium sempiternum. Amen.
text_pt: Aquele que tem, ele só, a imortalidade, e habita na luz inacessível; a quem nenhum dos homens viu nem pode ver, ao qual seja honra e poder sempiterno. Amém.
text_el: ὁ μόνος ἔχων ἀθανασίαν, φῶς οἰκῶν ἀπρόσιτον, ὃν εἶδεν οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ ἰδεῖν δύναται: ᾧ τιμὴ καὶ κράτος αἰώνιον: ἀμήν.

text_en: Charge the rich of this world not to be highminded nor to trust in the uncertainty of riches , but in the living God (who gives us abundantly all things to enjoy)
text_la: Divitibus hujus sæculi præcipe non sublime sapere, neque sperare in incerto divitiarum, sed in Deo vivo (qui præstat nobis omnia abunde ad fruendum)
text_pt: Manda aos ricos deste mundo que não sejam altivos, nem ponham a esperança na incerteza das riquezas, mas em Deus, que abundantemente nos dá todas as coisas para delas gozarmos;
text_el: Τοῖς πλουσίοις ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι παράγγελλε μὴ ὑψηλοφρονεῖν μηδὲ ἠλπικέναι ἐπὶ πλούτου ἀδηλότητι, ἀλλ' ἐπὶ θεῷ τῷ παρέχοντι ἡμῖν πάντα πλουσίως εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν,

text_en: to do good , to be rich in good works , to give easily, to communicate to others,
text_la: bene agere, divites fieri in bonis operibus, facile tribuere, communicare,
text_pt: Que façam bem, enriqueçam em boas obras, repartam de boa mente, e sejam comunicáveis;
text_el: ἀγαθοεργεῖν, πλουτεῖν ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς, εὐμεταδότους εἶναι, κοινωνικούς,

text_en: to lay up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on the true life.
text_la: thesaurizare sibi fundamentum bonum in futurum, ut apprehendant veram vitam.
text_pt: Que entesourem para si mesmos um bom fundamento para o futuro, para que possam se apoderar da vida eterna.
text_el: ἀποθησαυρίζοντας ἑαυτοῖς θεμέλιον καλὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον, ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται τῆς ὄντως ζωῆς.

text_en: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to your trust, avoiding the profane novelties of words and oppositions of knowledge falsely so called .
text_la: O Timothee, depositum custodi, devitans profanas vocum novitates, et oppositiones falsi nominis scientiæ,
text_pt: Ó Timóteo, guarda o depósito que te foi confiado, tendo horror aos clamores vãos e profanos e às oposições da falsamente chamada ciência,
text_el: Ὦ Τιμόθεε, τὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον, ἐκτρεπόμενος τὰς βεβήλους κενοφωνίας καὶ ἀντιθέσεις τῆς ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως,

text_en: Which some promising, have erred concerning the faith . Grace be with you. Amen .
text_la: quam quidam promittentes, circa fidem exciderunt. Gratia tecum. Amen.
text_pt: A qual professando-a alguns, se desviaram da fé. A graça seja contigo. Amém.
text_el: ἥν τινες ἐπαγγελλόμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἠστόχησαν. Ἡ χάρις μεθ' ὑμῶν.
